lesson.title: Why he told stories
lesson.carry: a story carries what a lecture can't
lesson.hook: Jesus rarely explained himself; he told a short story and let it sit with people (Mark 4:33–34)

title: why he told stories
hook: no lecture. no rules. just: listen.
cast: shot 3: Galilean farmers, fishers, mothers; today: an Ethiopian grandfather and grandkids in Addis Ababa.
